citations.narrative:
The licensee has not followed the sampling guidance for intestinal parasites according to the schedule written in the
Program of Veterinary Care (PVC). The PVC dictates that testing should be performed once per calendar year on 10% of
adults and on 5% of puppies twice per calendar year. According to the current animal inventory and estimated numbers of
litters, this should be about 5 adult dogs once per year, and 2-3 litters in each half of the year (Jan-June and July-Dec).
The licensee stated she has plans to test, but no dogs have been tested yet in 2026. In 2025, only 1 puppy was tested for
intestinal parasites. In 2024, only 2 adults and 3 litters were tested. Sampling is important to stay aware of parasites in
dogs and identify need for treatment if present. Correct by having dogs tested for intestinal parasites on a schedule as
written in the PVC.
Correct by: 07/31/2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with licensee.
